method: Read-only source snapshot inspection. No install, DB connection, production connection, runtime incident simulation, dependency vulnerability scan or product modification.

findings.title: Production frontend build toolchain drifts from CI
findings.observation: Dockerfile.web uses Node20 and prepares pnpm10.29; packageManager selects pnpm11.1.2; CI explicitly uses Node22 and records pnpm11 requires Node>=22.13. No Docker build gate exists in the inspected CI file.
findings.impact: A green host build/CI does not prove documented production container can rebuild.
findings.missingEvidence: NEEDS VERIFICATION: clean Docker build with exact lockfile; no build/install performed here. Do not assert observed Docker failure.

findings.title: Restore swallows pg_restore failure and health timeout
findings.observation: restore.sh converts any failing restore pipeline into a warning, then prints restored; subsequent healthcheck timeout breaks rather than exits. Table count is printed without expected integrity threshold.
findings.impact: Operator can receive positive recovery messages after incomplete restore. Health/table existence cannot prove data completeness.
findings.missingEvidence: NEEDS VERIFICATION: isolated failing-restore fixture and actual recovery drill; script NOT executed (destructive).

findings.title: Full backup may omit missing media and still announce completion
findings.observation: Missing media volume sets DO_MEDIA=false with a warning; summary still prints Backup complete and expected media filename. Local backup offsite transfer is only an echoed suggestion.
findings.impact: A DB-only artifact could be mistaken for full recoverability; local host loss threatens same-host backups.
findings.missingEvidence: UNKNOWN: production scheduled job, media volume presence, offsite copy, retention, encryption and restore history. No production access.

findings.title: Health endpoint measures liveness, not database readiness
findings.observation: GET /api/health always returns 200 status ok without touching dependencies; Docker backend healthcheck and restore verification use this endpoint. Startup pool Ping/runtime-role verification exists but is not ongoing readiness.
findings.impact: A database outage after boot need not turn HTTP health unhealthy.
findings.missingEvidence: NEEDS VERIFICATION: isolated post-start DB outage; no outage induced.

findings.title: Deployment operations snippet omits newly mandatory credentials
findings.observation: Canonical deployment env snippet omits APP_DATABASE_PASSWORD and MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEYS required by compose. The copied .env.production.example does include both, so following the full template can avoid this documentation trap.
findings.impact: Using only the shown snippet cannot start production compose; operator documentation drifts.
findings.missingEvidence: NEEDS VERIFICATION: operator deployment dry run; not proof a current production deployment is broken.

findings.title: CI coverage does not include production build, dependency scanning or host SketchUp proof
findings.observation: Inspected ci.yml runs ledger/OpenAPI, TS tests/typecheck, Foundation Gate A, Ruby/RBZ on three OSes and Go tests with PostgreSQL. It has no Docker/web production build or advisory scan step; licensed SketchUp smoke is explicitly manual. Actions use version tags rather than immutable commit SHAs.
findings.impact: Passing this workflow is strong tested-scope evidence, not deployment reproducibility, vulnerability-free dependencies or native-host UI proof.
findings.missingEvidence: UNKNOWN: repository protection settings, external CI scanners, actual current remote runs and manual host evidence (not queried in this subtask). No CVE claim.

findings.title: Catalog paths have query-count growth
findings.observation: ListOptionGroups reads all groups then queries members once per group (1+N); GetFullCatalog module loop calls detail loader per module, which loads component/board/hardware relations. Furniture definitions handler sequentially loads several complete catalog families. Member relation PK starts with option_group_id, so this is NOT a missing-index claim.
findings.impact: Higher catalog size adds database round trips and repeated hydration; backend pool fixed at max10 can amplify contention but no saturation measured.
findings.missingEvidence: NEEDS VERIFICATION: representative catalog trace, query count, EXPLAIN ANALYZE and p50/p95 under concurrent requests. No DB queried.

findings.title: Projects list includes heavy payloads without pagination
findings.observation: ListProjects selects cut_plan, design_revisions, approvals, change_orders and other JSON data for all visible projects; OR across owning/sales/manufacturing org and ORDER BY updated_at, no LIMIT. Single-column org indexes exist; this does not prove planner regression or missing useful index.
findings.impact: Payload and query cost grow with tenant project history; potential list-screen latency/memory risk.
findings.missingEvidence: NEEDS VERIFICATION: realistic row counts/JSON sizes, endpoint bytes and execution plans; do not infer latency from code alone.

findings.title: Observability baseline exists but operational SLO evidence is missing
findings.observation: JSON slog startup/error logs, Caddy JSON access logs, request IDs and process-local RLS denial counter exist. Inspected production compose and dependency manifests do not configure metrics/tracing/alert backends or centralized retention. This is a scoped absence, not a claim that no external monitoring exists.
findings.impact: Request identity helps investigation but does not establish alert routing, latency/error SLOs, durable metric retention or recoverability.
findings.missingEvidence: UNKNOWN: deployed dashboards, p95/error alerts, backup failure alerts, retention, incident response and on-call ownership.

findings.title: SketchUp root scans and complete furniture rerender need scale measurement
findings.observation: Selection fallback scans model.entities after active-path recovery fails. Duplicate rescan performs separate top-level passes for duplicates/unresolved/unsynced. Furniture edit clears/rebuilds its definition and scans orphan generated definitions, inside an undo operation; make_unique and abort handling protect scope. Migration scanner explicitly handles active top-level entities, not arbitrary nested legacy content.
findings.impact: Work scales with root entity/definition counts; risk in large models. No measured freeze/FPS or explicit redraw-loop defect established.
findings.missingEvidence: NEEDS VERIFICATION: licensed SketchUp profiling with 10/100/1000 units, selection/edit/copy/publish timings, UI-thread/redraw costs and save/reopen. Unit Ruby is insufficient.

findings.title: Backup gate can skip restore leg
findings.observation: Pilot wrapper warns and allows missing pg_dump/pg_restore. Go backup test skips when clients absent and also when pg_restore returns error. CI installs a PostgreSQL client, but that alone does not assert this specific leg ran without skip.
findings.impact: Generic green pilot/Go suite does not necessarily prove backup restore capability; need exact test outcome.
findings.missingEvidence: NEEDS VERIFICATION: inspect exact executed test log and confirm restore scenario PASS with zero skips; parent may hold relevant preflight evidence.

findings.title: Backend Docker builder differs from Go module minimum
findings.observation: Builder image is golang1.22, module declares Go1.25, CI uses1.25.x. Go toolchain auto-download may bridge this, so it is build-network/reproducibility drift rather than a proven failure.
findings.impact: Container build depends on behavior not covered by CI container gates; mutable image tags and unpinned toolchain retrieval weaken reproducibility.
findings.missingEvidence: NEEDS VERIFICATION: clean container build and resulting go version/build metadata; no image pull/build performed.

positiveControls.title: Production network and credential baseline
positiveControls.observation: Explicit required secrets, distinct runtime/migration URLs, production secure-cookie policy, internal network, nonroot backend and reverse-proxy security headers are present. Deployed effective state not verified.

positiveControls.title: Server request bounds and startup safety
positiveControls.observation: Fail-fast config/migration/runtime-role checks, read/header/write/idle timeouts and max header size exist.

positiveControls.title: Index baseline is real
positiveControls.observation: Tenant indexes and option membership PK exist; report does not claim absent indexing globally.

coverage.unknown: Clean Docker build and live VPS configuration
Remote checks/protection/external scanners; no advisory database lookup
Real production artifacts and isolated drill; scripts not run
Live dashboards, alert routing and retention
No SQL execution, plans or benchmark
